Travelers: Pet travel notice

Travelers with companion animals should check their booking details before arrival so the handoff at Aurelia Skyways stays smooth and calm. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help with clear guidance, gentle handling, and the right documents for each trip.

A safety coordinator reviews the animal areas for hazards and checks that prevention steps are in place before boarding. Cabin staff also keep watch during flight and make sure pets have the care they need along the way. <<FACT F028>> Please use approved carriers, label them clearly, and bring any required health papers so your visit can move ahead without delay.

If you are traveling through Port Isolde, plan ahead for lounge access and follow the signs on arrival. <<FACT F021>> Our team can help you with check-in, carrier checks, and any next steps if your pet needs extra support. Please keep your animal close, follow staff directions, and speak with us early if you expect a change in plans.

For help with companion animal travel at Aurelia Skyways, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
